audit.whatIsWrong: Every prose field calls Cassiopeia "he/his", and the lane difficulty story is told without the one mechanic that defines it: Miasma grounding Harsh Lesson.
audit.why: Cassiopeia's W Miasma (24/22/20/18/16s) grounds, and Illaoi's W Harsh Lesson is a leap — grounded, she cannot be closed on. That single interaction, not generic 'poke', is why the early lane is hers and why the 4-5 window is yours once it is on cooldown.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed to her, and Miasma's grounding of Harsh Lesson written into tldr, winCon, the trigger card and the key-interactions slot with the real 16s/24s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart in both layers reads Cassiopeia at levels 2, 3, 4-5 and 6, contradicting the packet chart AND its own whys text, which says Skill at 2, Illaoi from 3, Illaoi at 4-5 and Skill at 6.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Cassiopeia, Skill, Illaoi, Illaoi, Skill, Skill, Cassiopeia]; whys[1]-[5] already describe exactly that progression. Harsh Lesson at 3 plus Test of Spirit gives Illaoi a real window on an escape-less Cassiopeia, and at 6 Petrifying Gaze and Leap of Faith cancel out.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-4 flipped as matched full/content pairs with ratings updated; rows 0, 5 and 6 unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twin Fang's healing is never mentioned, so nothing tells the player to buy Grievous Wounds; and the grounding is described only as generic 'dashes disabled'.
audit.why: Twin Fang (E) is a 0.75s-cooldown attack that heals Cassiopeia for a share of the damage dealt, doubled up by the poison from Q. In an extended trade she out-sustains Illaoi's tentacle heal unless anti-heal is on the field. Miasma's grounding specifically kills Harsh Lesson (4s cooldown, 400 range), Illaoi's only gap-closer.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing written into the first-item spike; the grounding named against Harsh Lesson by name in the trigger card and key-interactions.

audit.why: Miasma is correctly identified as the punishable cooldown; only the number was missing.
